OROBAS.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.0-0.ancie: Mortal flesh... withers. Let the Touch elevate the work of your hands.
PAEL.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.2-0.ancient: The contract is sealed... no turning back.
PAEL.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.2-0.char: Turning back aside, my overdraw limit is what it is. You do the math.
PAEL.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.0-0.char: What are you staring at? Do I have a battle report on my face? ...If so, you owe me royalties.
DARV.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.1-0r.char: Still collecting these 'treasures', huh? Fine, let's see if any fits into my command terminal.
NONUPEIPE.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.0-0.ch: Every keeper in this place has a personality. Fine, let's get to business—don't make me work for free.
DARV.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.2-0.char: Just remember the discount next time. My ledger won't let me play the fool.
NEOW.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.0-0.char: Huh? A cat... no, the aura suggests high-grade Originium artifact. First off, I have no budget for a mascot.
TEZCATARA.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.1-0r.c: Blood doesn't lie, but budgets do. Let's get to the point.
VAKUU.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.0-0.char: The space around you feels off... hollowed out. Like my ledger after I overdraw.
TANX.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.1-0r.char: Nice armor. Want a free inspection? —Kidding. Labor costs extra.
OROBAS.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.0-0.char: Upgrade my terminal? Now that's a plan I can get behind. Just don't turn my overdraw into a bottomless pit.
VAKUU.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.1-0r.char: Nothingness calls? Perfect—I owe it, it owes me, we're even.
DARV.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.1-0r.ancien: Back again! I got the good stuff saved for ya!
OROBAS.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.1-0r.char: More efficient, I like it. Next time, can you throw in a couple extra Tactical Point slots?
TANX.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.2-0.char: Before we advance, let's split the loot. Fair trade, no funny business.
DARV.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.2-0.ancient: Ya got an eye for goods! Come back soon, I'll keep somethin' better!
TANX.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.0-0.char: A heavy unit? Funny, my Tactical Points excel at taking hits too. Just don't steal my intercepting job.
NEOW.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.1-0r.char: We meet again. My Tactical Points are on standby—don't hold up my shift. No overtime pay.
TEZCATARA.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.0-0.ch: The aura of an old civilization... interesting. If I weren't rushing to deploy Tactical Points, I'd love to study you.
DARV.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.0-0.ancient: Heya, new face! Take a look at my wares—got somethin' for everyone!
NONUPEIPE.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.2-0.ch: Fate may intertwine, but show me the reward list first.
OROBAS.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.2-0.char: Fine, leave the technical stuff to you. Just don't cook the books.
DARV.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.0-0.char: Hmm... a few of these are decent. Boss, can we talk price? Rhodes Island's budget is really tight.
PAEL.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.1-0r.char: Stare again and I'll start charging. By the minute.
VAKUU.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.2-0.char: All returns to void, but let me collect my payment first.
OROBAS.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.1-0r.anci: Your creation... has touched higher reason.
NONUPEIPE.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.1-0r.c: Back on shift. What's the pay this time? No pay, I just stand guard and don't lift a finger.
TEZCATARA.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.2-0.ch: The gods witness you; I only witness the ledger. We each take what we need.
NEOW.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.2-0.char: Fate's threads? Can I expense them? If not, let's talk about something practical.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.1-: Not before I get through you. We'll settle the bill later.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.2-: I've read your script, but I'll write my own ending. Tactical Points, engage!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.1-: You climbed again? You and your little machines are equally stubborn.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.0-: Maintain? Absurd. You cannot even manage your own energy.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.1-: They will be scrapped, just like you.
My Tactical Points are more dedicated than I am—they don't negotiate overtime pay.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.CLOSUREMOD-CLOSURE.0-: Come then. Prove your creations are worthy of this tower.
An engineer of Rhodes Island... you dare reach this far?
Overdraw is a tactic, not an accident. Old relics like you wouldn't get it.
Closure, engineer of Rhodes Island. I'm here to 'maintain' order in your tower—and to audit your so-called perfection.
